title: What are my hobbies?
content: I love coding, but I also enjoy other things in my free time. I love reading interesting books and playing video games like Farlight 84, Factorio, and Minecraft. Of course, I also enjoy watching movies — some of my favorites are A Bronx Tale, Geostorm, The Parent Trap, Little Miss Sunshine, and The Perks of Being a Wallflower. I have many more favorite movies, but these are definitely among the best.
